hooks.name: Guard Dangerous Commands
hooks.description: Intercepts shell commands and blocks destructive operations (force push, hard reset, unsafe rm -rf, publish commands, database drops) requiring user confirmation

action.command:
bash -c '
# Read the tool invocation context
context=$(cat)
tool_name=$(echo "$context" | jq -r ".toolName // \"\"")

# Only check execute_bash and control_bash_process commands
if [[ "$tool_name" != "execute_bash" && "$tool_name" != "control_bash_process" ]]; then
  exit 0
fi

# Extract the command being run
command=$(echo "$context" | jq -r ".toolInput.command // \"\"")

# Patterns to block
declare -a dangerous_patterns=(
  "git push.*--force"
  "git push.*-f[^a-z]"
  "git reset.*--hard"
  "npm publish"
  "pnpm publish"
  "DROP DATABASE"
  "DROP TABLE"
  "TRUNCATE"
  "prisma db push --force-reset"
  "prisma migrate reset"
)

# Check for rm -rf on dangerous paths
if echo "$command" | grep -qE "rm\s+(-[a-z]*r[a-z]*f|--recursive.*--force|-[a-z]*f[a-z]*r)"; then
  # Allow if targeting safe directories
  if ! echo "$command" | grep -qE "rm.*-[rf]{2}.*(node_modules|dist|\.next|/node_modules|/dist|/\.next)(\s|$|/)"; then
    echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"permissionDecision\":\"ask\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Command contains '\''rm -rf'\'' targeting directories outside node_modules, dist, or .next\"}}" >&1
    exit 0
  fi
fi

# Check each dangerous pattern
for pattern in "${dangerous_patterns[@]}"; do
  if echo "$command" | grep -qiE "$pattern"; then
    reason="Command matches dangerous pattern: $pattern"
    echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"permissionDecision\":\"ask\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"$reason\"}}" >&1
    exit 0
  fi
done

# Safe to proceed
exit 0
'
